We’re building a local-AI camera OS: SigmaStar cameras → RTSP → HDMI Node → on-device AI → zero cloud.

Think Android for CCTV, not another mobile app.

We need engineers who know: • Linux video pipelines (V4L2, GStreamer, FFmpeg) • RTSP / ONVIF • Edge AI (YOLO, NCNN, TFLite, OpenVINO)

This is founder-level work — small team, big system.
